title: Bank of England MPC decision (no Monetary Policy Report) — the first committee to meet with post-VAT-reversion CPI actually in hand, seven weeks after the forecast that had to book it blind
source: EST: bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy/upcoming-mpc-dates, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200) — the 2027 panel is headed 'Provisional dates' and lists 'Thursday 17 June' with no Monetary Policy Report beside it (the 2027 MPR months are February, April, July and November). Independently corroborated from a second BoE surface the same day: bankofengland.co.uk/news/2025/december/mpc-dates-for-2027, the Bank's own announcement 'Published on 18 December 2025', headed 'Provisional dates for Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) announcements on Bank Rate and publication of MPC meeting minutes and the quarterly Monetary Policy Report', carrying the same eight dates and the same four MPR months. Filed estimate because the Bank labels its own 2027 dates PROVISIONAL and because market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has FED: and no slot for a non-Fed central bank. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of boe-decision-2027-04-29, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED BY THE boe-decision-2027-04-29 LANE, 2026-09-09, as the RESOLUTION VENUE for the sequencing argument that lane exists to carry, not merely as the next meeting on a schedule. The chain, every date from a fetched primary: MPC 2027-03-18 (no MPR, pre-lapse) -> the electricity-VAT reversion 2027-04-01 (SI 2026/987 lapses 31 March 2027) -> UK CPI for March data 2027-04-21 (ONS, fetched, 'not yet published' — still a zero-rated collection month) -> the April MPR on 2027-04-29, which must publish a forecast BOOKING the reversion with no post-reversion observation -> UK CPI for April data 2027-05-19 (ONS, fetched, 'not yet published' — the FIRST observation) -> THIS MEETING, 2027-06-17, the first committee to sit with it, and by then with the May print too (the series runs monthly, so a May-data bulletin lands around 2027-06-16). Forecast to first-committee is 49 days. THAT GAP IS THE POINT: a self-reversing tax notch whose forecast round and first observation never coincide is the textbook thing a committee looks through, which is why the parent lane's stance is a LOOK-THROUGH argument and NOT a rate call — the parent registers no directional Bank Rate test, and this proposal registers none either. What this meeting is FOR, in the parent's ledger, is that it is where 'did the committee look through it' stops being a hypothesis: the June minutes are the first that CAN discuss the observed April step, and they carry no MPR to hide it in. NO DIRECTIONAL VIEW ON BANK RATE IS PROPOSED HERE. Tiered medium to match every other BoE MPC decision on this calendar (boe-decision-2026-09-17, -2026-11-05, -2026-12-17) and the BoJ decisions; symbols: [], and this calendar's tracked universe is eight US mega-caps with no UK listing, gilt or sterling instrument. Estimate widens caution only, and the Bank's 2027 dates are its own provisional ones — re-check them against its published calendar before anything is keyed to this date.
